# Pier Luigi Dovesi

> Personal website of Pier Luigi Dovesi — AI researcher, robotics engineer, and non-profit founder based in Stockholm, Sweden.

## Pages

- [About](/#about): who I am and what I work on.
- [Selected Research](/#research): papers, contributions, and project or code links.
- [Talks & Podcasts](/#talks): keynotes, conference talks, and podcast appearances.
- [News](/#news): recent updates, publications, and announcements.
- [Timeline](/#timeline): roles, education, and career history.
- [Writing](/#writing): essays and blog posts.

## About

Co-Founder and Chair of The Good AI Lab, an independent AI lab working on foundational AI research and innovation projects for social good, partnering with Doctors Without Borders (MSF), FMSI, and several universities across Europe.

Leads the Robotics and Autonomous Systems team at AMD Silo AI, working on world action models, multimodal AI, and embodied intelligence.

Research spans domain adaptation, self-supervised learning, and real-time perception, with recent work extending toward vision-language models. Publications at CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, 3DV, BMVC, and ICRA.

## Current Roles

- Co-Founder & Chair, The Good AI Lab (2025–present) — https://thegoodailab.org
- Robotics Lead, AMD Silo AI (2024–present)

## Previous Roles

- Senior AI Scientist & Expert Lead, Silo AI (2023 – 2024)
- Deep Learning Engineer, Univrses / consulting at Zenseact (2019 – 2023)
- MSc Systems, Control & Robotics, KTH Royal Institute of Technology (2017 – 2019)
- BSc Automation Engineering, University of Bologna & Tongji University (2013 – 2017)

## Selected Publications

- Mind the Heads (HeRA) (NeurIPS 2026): Aligns individual attention heads with a vision model to improve visual reasoning and reduce hallucinations in multimodal LLMs.
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23885 | Project: https://aimagelab.github.io/HeRA/
- Seeing Beyond Words (JARVIS) (Preprint · 2025): Teaches multimodal LLMs to learn visual structure directly from images, beyond what text descriptions can convey.
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.15885 | Project: https://github.com/aimagelab/JARVIS
- VocAlign (BMVC 2025): Adapts image segmentation to new environments by aligning category vocabularies, without access to the original training data.
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15225 | Code: https://github.com/Sisso16/VocAlign
- Semantic Library Adaptation (SemLA) (CVPR 2025): Retrieves and combines lightweight model adapters to tailor segmentation to each image, without additional training at test time.
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.21780 | Code: https://github.com/rezaqorbani/SemLA
- HAMLET — real-time online domain adaptation (ICCV 2023)
- OnDA — online domain adaptation (ECCV 2022)
- Real-Time Semantic Stereo Matching (ICRA 2020)
